_readme: Project-owned exceptions for the ProjexLight pre-commit security scan. Reviewed like code.
Prefer fixing a finding, or waiving one line with 'projexlight-ignore <RULE-ID>: <reason>'.
Each entry needs a path glob, the rule ids it exempts and a reason.

ignores.reason: ProjexLight tooling; the flagged queries read pg_database (the Postgres system catalog), which has no tenant column. No application data is queried.
